grammar_title: 名词性从句综合复习(主语/宾语/表语/同位语从句 · 连接词选择)
source: 外研社版选择性必修第四册 Unit 5 Using language: Review noun clauses。玛雅文明/探索未知主题;句子地道、答案唯一(干扰项为错误连接词:that-vs-what、if-vs-whether、which 等,只一个成立);零术语、纯应用型。

points.point: 主语从句与宾语从句(what / that / whether · if vs whether)
points.overview: 从句缺主语或宾语时用 what;陈述完整事实用 that;表'是否'(尤其句首作主语、介词后、紧跟 or not)用 whether,此时不能用 if。

points.point: 表语从句与同位语从句(The question is whether… · the fact/idea/news THAT…)
points.overview: 表语从句承接 be 动词,缺成分用 what、完整事实用 that、是否用 whether;同位语从句说明 fact/idea/news/belief 等名词的内容,内容完整用 that,内容为'是否'用 whether。

points.point: 名词性从句连接词的选择(that vs what · whether vs if · whatever/whoever/however)
points.overview: 内容完整无缺用 that、缺成分用 what;'是否'用 whether(or not/介词后不用 if);表'无论……'引导让步或'凡是'用 whatever/whoever/however。

questions.stem: ____ caused the Maya to abandon their cities is still unknown.
questions.explanation: 从句 caused 前缺主语,只有 what 能在句中作主语并引导主语从句。

questions.stem: The carvings prove ____ the Maya understood the stars very well.
questions.explanation: 从句内容完整、陈述事实,宾语从句用 that。

questions.stem: No one can read exactly ____ the old symbols mean.
questions.explanation: mean 后缺宾语,用 what 在从句中作宾语。

questions.stem: Experts are not sure ____ a drought alone destroyed the cities or not.
questions.explanation: 紧跟 or not 只能用 whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: ____ really puzzles archaeologists is the speed of the collapse.
questions.explanation: puzzles 前缺主语,主语从句用 what。

questions.stem: Many people believe ____ the Maya tracked the planets carefully.
questions.explanation: 内容完整的陈述,宾语从句用 that。

questions.stem: Their survival depended on ____ enough rain fell each year.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后引导'是否'的从句用 whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: The guide explained ____ the ancient farmers grew in those wet fields.
questions.explanation: grew 后缺宾语,用 what 作宾语。

questions.stem: ____ the Maya had no metal tools makes their work all the more amazing.
questions.explanation: 从句内容完整、作主语陈述事实,用 That。

questions.stem: Scientists wonder ____ the survivors moved north or not.
questions.explanation: 紧跟 or not 用 whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: ____ the deep jungle still hides may never be fully known.
questions.explanation: hides 后缺宾语,主语从句用 What。

questions.stem: The ruins show clearly ____ a great people once lived there.
questions.explanation: 内容完整的陈述,宾语从句用 that。

questions.stem: Researchers cannot agree on ____ the ancient writing system recorded.
questions.explanation: recorded 后缺宾语,介词 on 后用 what 引导并作宾语。

questions.stem: We do not know ____ war or disease ended the cities or not.
questions.explanation: 紧跟 or not 用 whether。

questions.stem: The new study suggests ____ the droughts lasted for several years.
questions.explanation: 内容完整的陈述,宾语从句用 that。

questions.stem: ____ happened to the last Maya rulers remains a mystery.
questions.explanation: happened 前缺主语,主语从句用 What。

questions.stem: There is much debate about ____ the calendar was truly accurate.
questions.explanation: 介词 about 后引导'是否'的从句用 whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: Old records tell us ____ the city was once full of life.
questions.explanation: 内容完整的陈述,宾语从句用 that。

questions.stem: I often wonder ____ the ancient builders left behind in the jungle.
questions.explanation: left behind 后缺宾语,用 what 作宾语。

questions.stem: It is unclear ____ the warnings came too late or not.
questions.explanation: 紧跟 or not 用 whether。

questions.stem: The fact ____ the Maya had a true writing system surprises many people.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句说明 fact 的内容、内容完整,用 that。

questions.stem: The big question is ____ a single disaster destroyed them all or not.
questions.explanation: 表语从句、紧跟 or not,用 whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: The idea ____ farming changed the land seems very likely.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句说明 idea、内容完整,用 that。

questions.stem: That long silence is ____ still troubles every archaeologist.
questions.explanation: troubles 前缺主语,表语从句用 what。

questions.stem: The news ____ a new temple had been found excited the whole team.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句说明 news、内容完整,用 that。

questions.stem: The truth is ____ no one has fully read their writing yet.
questions.explanation: 表语从句、内容完整陈述事实,用 that。

questions.stem: The belief ____ the stars guided the Maya is a very old one.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句说明 belief、内容完整,用 that。

questions.stem: The real issue is ____ the rains failed for many years or not.
questions.explanation: 表语从句、紧跟 or not,用 whether。

questions.stem: There is strong evidence ____ the population grew far too fast.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句说明 evidence、内容完整,用 that。

questions.stem: This empty city is ____ remains of a once-great civilisation.
questions.explanation: remains 前缺主语,表语从句用 what(=所剩下的东西)。

questions.stem: The discovery ____ the calendar was accurate amazed the scientists.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句说明 discovery、内容完整,用 that。

questions.stem: Our main doubt is ____ the theory can ever be proved or not.
questions.explanation: 表语从句、紧跟 or not,用 whether。

questions.stem: The hope ____ the writing will one day be read keeps them going.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句说明 hope、内容完整,用 that。

questions.stem: A true writing system was ____ made the Maya unique in the Americas.
questions.explanation: made 前缺主语,表语从句用 what。

questions.stem: The theory ____ humans harmed the land has gained much support.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句说明 theory、内容完整,用 that。

questions.stem: One surprising fact is ____ the cities were never rebuilt.
questions.explanation: 表语从句、内容完整陈述事实,用 that。

questions.stem: The question ____ the people left by choice still divides experts.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句说明 question 的'是否'内容,用 whether;question 后不用 if 引导同位语。

questions.stem: The mystery is ____ the drought alone caused everything or not.
questions.explanation: 表语从句、紧跟 or not,用 whether。

questions.stem: The fact ____ they built without the wheel makes it more amazing.
questions.explanation: 同位语从句说明 fact、内容完整,用 that。

questions.stem: The Maya calendar is ____ first drew me to study this people.
questions.explanation: drew 前缺主语,表语从句用 what。

questions.stem: Everyone agrees ____ the Maya were remarkably skilled builders.
questions.explanation: 内容完整的陈述,用 that;无缺成分不用 what。

questions.stem: Nobody knows for sure ____ lies beneath the jungle floor.
questions.explanation: lies 前缺主语,用 what;内容有缺不用 that。

questions.stem: Tell me ____ the city was abandoned suddenly or not.
questions.explanation: 紧跟 or not 用 whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: ____ the ancient farmers harvested each year fed a huge population.
questions.explanation: harvested 后缺宾语,主语从句用 What;内容有缺不用 That。

questions.stem: The old map shows ____ the cities lay close to certain bright stars.
questions.explanation: 内容完整的陈述,用 that。

questions.stem: Much still depends on ____ the rains will return this season.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后引导'是否'的从句用 whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: The Maya carefully recorded ____ they saw in the night sky.
questions.explanation: 作 recorded 与 saw 的宾语、指'凡是看到的事物',用 whatever。

questions.stem: ____ first entered the silent ruins must have felt truly amazed.
questions.explanation: 指'无论是谁'、作主语并指人,用 Whoever。

questions.stem: ____ hard scientists search, some answers still stay hidden.
questions.explanation: 后接形容词 hard 表'无论多么……',用 However。

questions.stem: It is now clear ____ a great people once lived in these valleys.
questions.explanation: 内容完整的陈述,用 that。

questions.stem: The priests' writing recorded ____ the rulers wanted to remember.
questions.explanation: remember 后缺宾语,用 what。

questions.stem: Ask the local guide ____ the temple is open to visitors or not.
questions.explanation: 紧跟 or not 用 whether。

questions.stem: The jungle slowly covered ____ the people had left behind.
questions.explanation: 作 covered 与 left 的宾语、指'凡是留下的东西',用 whatever。

questions.stem: A rich reward would go to ____ first found the lost city.
questions.explanation: 指'无论是谁'、指人作 found 的主语,用 whoever。

questions.stem: ____ carefully we look, the true cause is hard to find.
questions.explanation: 后接副词 carefully 表'无论多么……',用 However。

questions.stem: Few people doubt ____ the calendar was a great achievement.
questions.explanation: 否定句 few...doubt 后内容完整,用 that。

questions.stem: ____ destroyed the great cities is still fiercely debated today.
questions.explanation: destroyed 前缺主语,主语从句用 What。

questions.stem: There is real doubt about ____ war played any part at all.
questions.explanation: 介词 about 后引导'是否'的从句用 whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: Future explorers will study ____ the deep jungle finally reveals.
questions.explanation: 作 study 与 reveals 的宾语、指'凡是揭示出的东西',用 whatever。

questions.stem: Old legends say ____ the gods once walked among the people.
questions.explanation: 内容完整的陈述,用 that。
